correctionSummary.reason: Final system release closing the correctness-remediation and visual-modernization program for Too Clean a Room.
corrections: C2C5-T02 Rubric system. The Teacher Guide carried no common quick rubric and no 4/3/2/1 analytic rubric; both are now printed.
C2C5-T03 Authoritative sources. The guide had source-status prose but no printed authoritative reference list; the list is now printed.
C2C5-ACC01 Accessible workload. Accessible Task 4 required ten source-analysis responses plus synthesis and was reduced without changing the accepted response space.
C2C5-ACC02 Accessible Task 5 still required four B/R marks, three written rejections and all three mechanism stages despite useful supports; the load was reduced with partial completion.
C2C5-T01 Teacher structure is validated against the corrected functional set rather than a fixed page count; nine Teacher pages are retained.
C2C5-VIS01, VIS02 and VIS03 Detection-limit teaching graphic, six-month production monitor and the mechanism/trial workflow modernized through the shared visual layer.
unchanged: Curriculum wording beyond the corrections listed above, scientific conclusions, task order, response controls and persistence identities, presentation CSS, layout overrides, fixed Letter page geometry and learner-field sizing are unchanged from the owner-approved corrective and visually modernized state.
